contribution_requirements: npm run check:copy rejects em dashes (U+2014) and encoded equivalents (—, —, —, \u2014) across src/ and README.md. npm run format:check enforces prettier (2-space indent, double quotes, trailing commas, semicolons - match existing files). Keep visual-disclosure language for illustrative data. Decorative visuals must be aria-hidden/alt=''.
key_patterns: App Router: src/app/{page,about-us,contact-us,projects,services}. layout.tsx loads fonts via next/font/google and exposes CSS vars (--font-*), mounts <Nav/> {children} <Footer/> <MotionControl/> + Organization JSON-LD. globals.css has an `@theme {}` token block (--color-*, --font-*) then plain semantic-class CSS. Nav.tsx is a client component using next/link + usePathname for active state; Footer.tsx is server. MotionControl.tsx is the site-wide client motion controller: sets html[data-js], toggles data-motion on [data-animated-visual] via IntersectionObserver + localStorage toggle, respects prefers-reduced-motion, no-JS safe. Content lives in src/content/*.ts (site, editorial, projects, services, industries, about). Images via next/image. site.stats already holds the prototype's 4 metric-bar values.
